name: omega!? my guide?
source:
Omega from birth, our MC has been wanting to become a powerful figure in a world where Espers and Guides rule the world. Unfortunately for him, power comes at a cost and his dreams of bossing around Alphas and Betas are dashed when he finds himself entangled and bound to another omega. 

What are the goddamn odds? His dreams are over... aren't they?

[From [url=https://labyrintheexe.itch.io/omega-my-guide]itch.io[/url]]
